I will plant this small rented root-crop plot the way I can manage with my household. Here in the South East, we usually depend on the rains, and for a small intercropped plot like this I will use some manure if I can get it, but I will not spend much on chemical fertilizer. I will keep to local planting material, use family labor for most of the work, and only hire a little help when the work is heavy.
